title: Four Wang Kelian trafficking convicts among six Thais repatriated
summary: KANGAR: Six Thais, including four convicted in connection with the 2015 Wang Kelian migrant smuggling camps and mass graves, were repatriated to Thailand yesterday after completing their prison sentences.
